Attentive Service but a Dining Experience That Falls Short of Expectations
Aug 2026 • Couples
I recently went to Matsuri Nguyễn Huệ for dinner, and the experience was good but nothing outstanding. There were many positive points but a few blips along the way.

Food
Most of the dishes were acceptable. Nothing stood out, though most dishes were done well enough.
Their special yuzu beef dish has a pleasant yuzu sauce flavor. However, the sauce was too watery, so it could not coat the beef well and made for a less satisfying taste.
It would also be good to get the kitchen to serve food more quickly. We were a large group and expected to be served more quickly than we were.

Service
The service staff were as you would expect at a high-quality restaurant: very attentive, always courteous, and took great care to ensure all our requirements were met.

Overall Impression
A decent experience all round. Although Matsuri Nguyễn Huệ delivered a satisfactory experience, the long wait for the dishes was extremely disappointing and, let us face it, some parts of the food could have been better executed; for example, the yuzu sauce was too thin to coat the beef.

Overall, the dinner was good enough to make me want to go back to other restaurants in the area.
